Name: Corn and Green Beans (Also SVE Cucumbers)
Author: pomarf
Description:
[color=#666666]This is a really old mod I made for personal use in like 2018 and never uploaded, so I updated it for 1.6 and decided to share it. [/color]
[b][size=5]Green bean plants are too green so I made them less green.[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]Corn plants having yellow when they're not ready makes me sad.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]This mod changes those things.[/size][/b]
[b][size=2]That's it. [/size][/b]
[b][size=1]That's all it does...[/size][/b]

[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=4]Optional SVE Cucumber textures are also available.[/size][/color][/b]

[color=#666666][size=4][b]I'm probably a little color blind honestly.[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#666666][size=4][b]I hope this mod helps save your farm from bankruptcy or something.[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][b][color=#980000]Thanks to the lovely [/color][color=#6fa8dc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/bezajel]bezajel[/url][/color][color=#980000], this mod will now work with other content patcher mods that replace vanilla crop textures, as long as they don't replace the entire tilesheet. [/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][color=#6d9eeb]If you have a second, please feel free to swing by their profile and give them kudos for that. :)[/color][/b][/size]


[color=#980000][size=4][b]Disclaimer:[/b][/size][/color]
[i][color=#ffffff]I highly doubt I will ever update this mod, I tend to make things and forget about them for a few years.[/color][/i]
[color=#980000][u]So feel free to update it and re-upload or something [u]if any of the following emergencies[/u] take place:[/u][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#980000]If this mod stops working in the future and you want to update it, just maybe throw me some credit.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#980000]Or if you wanna use this mod as part your own mod, again, credit would be pretty cool.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#980000]Or if you are just curious and wanna see how it works, that is also a completely valid option.[/color][/*]
[/list]
